title: Mall world parking lot
content: I have chill bumps on my whole body right now. I can’t believe I’ve stumbled upon this sub! I’ve been dreaming of a mall since I was a child. I usually visit it at night when it’s closed and all of the lights are off and most of the dream takes place in the dark back parking lot. There are a few dim lights in the parking lot. I’ve been inside once or twice during daylight hours, though it’s always grayer and less sunny than real life. Or maybe they’re both real life, Im questioning reality now. This mall has been the setting for countless dreams. The dark parking lot seems to be my meet up place with others. They usually drive up in their own cars but sometimes are waiting there for me. There is a sidewalk that I always end up walking on when I leave the mall and it curves beside a chain link fence that leads to another building. Maybe a school? It’s always dark so it’s hard to tell. There are dim lights near the sidewalk but I always know I’m possibly in danger and totally creeped out as I walk on that sidewalk. There are woods or a forest nearby with a winding curvy road that is build up high so you are mid height with the trees in one particular curve. These woods have been a huge part of my dreams. I always know I’m near the mall when I see woods. Strange things happen in the woods. I’m always driving a small red convertible car. I’ve never owned one or had any connection to one in real life. I’m going to try to read more stories here and see if anything jogs my memory!
